formDescription: Shown when requesting records on behalf of another person. Collects that person's identifying information and requires an attached signed consent or proof of authority.

first_name.title: First name
first_name.description: The other person's legal first name.

middle_name.title: Middle name
middle_name.description: The other person's legal middle name, if any.

last_name.title: Last name
last_name.description: The other person's legal last name.

also_known_as.title: Also known as
also_known_as.description: Any other name(s) the person is or was known by.

date_of_birth.title: What is the person's date of birth?
date_of_birth.description: The other person's date of birth. Must not be a future date.

proof_of_authorization.title: Attach signed consent or proof of authority
proof_of_authorization.description: A single-file attachment proving the applicant's authority to request records on this person's behalf, or that person's signed, informed consent.
